close_reason: Migrated 6 Card metadata and filter UTCDate fields from Option<String> to Option<UTCDate>. Wire format unchanged (transparent newtype). Fixed test in lib.rs:560-563 to use .as_ref().map(AsRef::as_ref) since UTCDate doesn't impl Deref. Downstream jmap-contacts-server and jmap-contacts-client compile and tests pass. cargo clippy -p jmap-contacts-types -- -D warnings clean. RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc clean.
description:
Audit follow-up from JMAP-g7wu.9.5. Migrate 6 public String fields documented as UTCDate/UTCDateTime to jmap_types::UTCDate.

Sites (all in crate-jmap-contacts-types/src/card.rs):

1. line 52  — Card::created: Option<String>  (doc says 'Date and time when the Card was created (UTCDateTime)')
2. line 81  — Card::updated: Option<String>  (doc says 'last modified (UTCDateTime; server-set)')
3. line 235 — CardFilterCondition::created_before: Option<String>  (doc says 'must be before this UTCDateTime')
4. line 239 — CardFilterCondition::created_after: Option<String>  (doc says 'must be equal to or after this UTCDateTime')
5. line 243 — CardFilterCondition::updated_before: Option<String>  (doc says 'must be before this UTCDateTime')
6. line 247 — CardFilterCondition::updated_after: Option<String>  (doc says 'must be equal to or after this UTCDateTime')

Change:
  Option<String> -> Option<UTCDate>

API break — 0.2.0 class. Coordinate with sibling beads (calendars-types, tasks-types, filenode-types) per workspace cookie-cutter rule. Canonical extension-types crate is jmap-mail-types (already fully migrated).

Test approach: update any RFC-example fixture tests to construct UTCDate via UTCDate::new_validated() or UTCDate::from() — wire JSON unchanged because UTCDate is a transparent newtype around String.

Acceptance:
- cargo test -p jmap-contacts-types passes.
- cargo clippy -p jmap-contacts-types -- -D warnings clean.
- All 6 fields use Option<UTCDate>.
- Downstream jmap-contacts-server and jmap-contacts-client still compile.
- RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-contacts-types --no-deps clean.
title: UTCDate migration in jmap-contacts-types (Card metadata and filter bounds)
